name: Yunjing Digitech Group Limited
summary: Millennium Pacific Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise primarily engaged in the creation, production, and distribution of consumer electronic devices. The company's business activities extend across the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. Its diverse product line includes fitness trackers, GPS navigation systems, mobile internet devices, and television set-top boxes. In addition to manufacturing, the firm also trades electronic goods and develops and sells software applications. Furthermore, Millennium Pacific offers comprehensive services to its clients, encompassing design, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly, and packaging for their products. Established in 2004, the company is headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
